seed_proof.scope: Original script checks counts/content fingerprints of all7 tables; each fresh FILE_COPY clone independently checks users/articles only.

host_memory_witness.scope: Diagnostic only; shared physical Mac pressure never retroactively excludes attempts.

runs.interpretation: Four native histograms are verified by exact bin sum. At fixed closed-model load, similar request rates do not establish equal capacity; lower latency or CPU per success is diagnostic only. No warmup/search/5min hold, official x86 score, or ranking proof.
